item.address: 12/1 East Crescent Street, McMahons Point NSW 2060, NSW 2060
item.description:
Experience the pinnacle of harbourside living in this house-sized residence, perfectly positioned at the tip of McMahons Point. Featuring a private entrance shared with only one other residence, it offers a level of peace, privacy, and exclusivity rarely found on Sydney Harbour.

Set within a prestigious and tightly held building, this exceptional home delivers an unrivalled sense of space, privacy, and scope for enhancement.

The vast entertainer's terrace provides a front-row seat to Sydney's most iconic views, capturing a breathtaking 270-degree panorama-from the Harbour Bridge and Opera House across to the Barangaroo skyline and Anzac Bridge.

While beautifully maintained, the true opportunity lies in its potential to be transformed into a world-class residence, perfectly befitting its world-class location.

Features:
Coveted position within the exclusive, secure Point House
Generous house-like proportions with approximately 290sqm on title
Expansive open-plan living and dining areas
Oversized main bedroom that opens onto the terrace
Elegant blend of timber flooring and quality carpeting
Well-appointed modern kitchen with gas and electric appliances
Reverse-cycle air conditioning throughout
Lock-up tandem garage conveniently located opposite the entry
Short stroll to McMahons Point village, cafés, and ferry wharf
Easy access to North Sydney Station, North Sydney Metro and the CBD
